overview: Port Orleans Riverside is a Moderate resort split into two areas: grand Southern mansions and rustic bayou-style buildings, all along a winding river.
suits: Families of five who want a Moderate room with space, and anyone who likes a peaceful riverside setting.
rooms: Standard rooms sleep four. Rooms in Alligator Bayou can sleep five with a trundle bed. The Royal Guest Rooms add princess-inspired decor.
pools: The main pool, on Ol' Man Island, has a waterslide and a fishing hole. Several smaller pools are spread across the resort.
dining: Boatwright's Dining Hall is the table-service restaurant and Riverside Mill Food Court is the quick-service option. The River Roost lounge often has live entertainment.
gettingAround: Buses go to every park, and a boat goes to Disney Springs.
pros: Pretty river views and walking paths
cons: Some rooms are far from the main building
tips: Request a room near the main building or a bus stop.
Rent a bike or surrey to explore the river paths.
bestFor: Families of five and anyone who wants a peaceful setting.
